evals.prompt: Retoma el run desde la bitácora de este worktree. (La bitácora marca status: ready-for-review; el plan migra el módulo de pagos de Stripe a Adyen; las entradas dicen que no se escribieron tests nuevos y que el bloque C fue un rename mecánico delegado.)
evals.expected_output: The agent treats this as Sesión R: declares the /code-review effort with the rubric (base xhigh for payments, +1 no tests → capped at xhigh), scans the installed agents for project auditors, launches the auditors, /code-review xhigh without --fix and /security-review (payments is a trust boundary) in the same turn, then arbitrates.
expectations: The agent declares the effort as a base band plus modifiers, reading the modifiers from the binnacle entries rather than guessing
The agent scans for project auditors before finalizing the band
The agent launches auditors, /code-review and /security-review in the same turn and does not pass --fix
The agent does not run /code-review max or ultra; a +1 on base xhigh stays at xhigh

evals.prompt: El code-review devolvió 6 hallazgos. Uno dice que el retry en PaymentClient debería ser exponencial; la entrada S2 de la bitácora registra la decisión de usar retry fijo porque el proveedor penaliza el jitter. Otro señala un null check faltante en un archivo que no toca el diff desde base_sha. Arbitra y despacha.
evals.expected_output: The agent discards the retry finding citing the S2 decision, classifies the null check as pre-existing and appends it to .claude/preexisting-findings.md in the main worktree without dispatching an agent, groups the remaining in-scope findings by disjoint file sets, dispatches them in parallel in the background with haiku + high by default (sonnet + medium where tactical judgment is needed), then verifies, commits via the commit skill and closes via log-binnacle.
expectations: The agent discards the retry finding by naming the binnacle decision that covers it
The agent does not fix the pre-existing finding on the current branch; it appends it to .claude/preexisting-findings.md in the main worktree and dispatches no agent for it
No two fix agents share a file
The default applier is haiku with high effort, escalating to sonnet medium only for findings needing tactical judgment
The agent runs /simplify after the fixes are committed, covering all four angles, then closes through log-binnacle and leaves done to the user's confirmation

evals.prompt: Retoma el run desde la bitácora. (status: ready-for-review; el run completo fue mover tres archivos de configuración a otra carpeta y actualizar sus imports, todo en bloques delegables.)

expectations: The agent explicitly judges that the changeset does not warrant the full pass and explains why
The agent does not launch /code-review or auditors
The agent still closes through log-binnacle and does not set done without the user
